connector.name: Propstack MCP
connector.registryDescription: Connect AI assistants to your Propstack real estate CRM (contacts, properties, deals).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package propstack-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ashev87 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PROPSTACK_API_KEY
env.description: Your Propstack V1 API key (Verwaltung > API-Schluessel in crm.propstack.de). Determines which endpoints are accessible.
